name: Open-Resource Mature-Knowledge Subtraction
next: Do not promote to Constitution. Next evidence should measure subtraction yield/search cost/false-novelty prevention or replicate outside the current owner family; Finance remains useful when transport authority becomes available.
promotionRationale: Three witnesses are heterogeneous in object, method and external literature ecology.
All three use owner-native anomalies to narrow search but require independent public external evidence for mapping/repair.
All three preserve negative/non-novel findings as positive epistemic output instead of forcing novelty.
At least one witness (SCD) rejects multiple explicit novelty hypotheses; Human rejects broad/universal reductions; Media rejects candidate-continent-to-Foundation promotion.
Host supplies a distinct mapping-weak case where mature knowledge resolves the external-coordinate gap without erasing owner-specific residuals or promoting them to novelty.
whyNotConstitutional: The pattern has not yet been compared against alternative search/review strategies under controlled cost/quality measures.
Open-resource quality and coverage vary strongly by domain; some fields may depend on paywalled, tacit, proprietary or non-digitized knowledge.
A useful candidate method must remain optional enough not to suppress genuinely exploratory research before a residual is well formed.
Four owner cases remain a small, non-random sample inside one research programme.
The Host witness demonstrates residual-preservation but does not yet provide controlled evidence that this pattern outperforms alternative literature-review/search strategies.
Finance/Harness and domain-external replication remain unavailable, and open-resource coverage still varies sharply across disciplines.

witnesses.witness: G1-G4 independent formal-gap hypotheses were rejected after targeted mature-theory subtraction; useful typed coordination/integration residues survived without local-theory invention.

Human HF/HD/HOC pressures were mapped against mature psychology/cognitive/consciousness/affective/developmental/language/life sciences; broad Biology/Medicine and universal-person reductions were not promoted.

Communication/audience/meaning/archive/interface/presence candidate continents survived as derived/cross-owner structures while external Communication/Media/Semiotics/HCI fields absorbed broad novelty; MF10 remained unadmitted.

Host weak mapping was attacked using OMG/CNCF workflow/process and W3C provenance standards. Mature external spaces absorbed lifecycle/orchestration and lineage/provenance surfaces; exact revision/lease, response-loss-safe replay, owner-opacity and local-integrity residues remained owner-specific without novelty promotion.
